name: kopya
title: Kopya
description: Access and manipulate your clipboard history.
author: jns

commands.name: history
commands.title: History
commands.subtitle: List entries in your history
commands.description: List some, or all, entries in your history.

commands.name: enable-private-mode
commands.title: Enable Private Mode
commands.subtitle: Stop recording clipboard history
commands.description: Enable private mode to temporarily stop recording clipboard history, with optional timer.

commands.name: disable-private-mode
commands.title: Disable Private Mode
commands.subtitle: Resume recording clipboard history
commands.description: Disable private mode and resume recording clipboard history.

commands.name: private-mode-status
commands.title: Private Mode Status
commands.subtitle: Check private mode status
commands.description: Check if private mode is enabled and view timer details, if active.

preferences.name: apiUrl
preferences.title: API URL
preferences.description: URL of the clipboard history API server
preferences.label: API URL

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
